conventions.imd: IMD day D = 08:30 IST D-1 to 08:30 IST D; mean/max over 0.25 deg cells covering the study area
conventions.chirps: UTC calendar day, mean over 0.05 deg cells
conventions.era5: IST calendar-day total at the wettest of 9 ERA5 nodes
conventions.p_loyo: leave-one-season-out probability that the day is a documented waterlogging day (ERA5 model)
conventions.excluded: days -1/+1/+2 around documented events are omitted
